alice: hey team — customer ACME reports duplicate token charges for a single user action. Ticket ACME-487. Invoice INV-2026-0034 shows two identical token lines for req_01H8XYZ. Can we triage?

samir: can you drop the ledger rows + any request headers? did they send an Idempotency-Key?

alice: attaching snippets below. customer says they only clicked once. SDK used: redwood-js v0.9.4, no idempotency header observed in their capture.

alice: ```
# ingress logs
[2026-03-16T12:03:20.912Z] req=req_01H8XYZ route=/v1/generate upstream=10.2.3.4 status=499 svc=ingress-proxy
[2026-03-16T12:03:21.112Z] req=req_01H8XYZ route=/v1/generate upstream=10.2.3.4 status=200 svc=runtime
```

nina: 499 means client closed the connection -> likely client-side timeout triggered a retry. gateway has retry/backoff settings. do we correlate by body hash or idempotency-key?

infra-oncall-bot: deploy 2026-03-16T11:55:00 v2.4.1 -> ingress-proxy (retry-backoff=100ms, max-tries=3)

samir: if the client retried and there was no Idempotency-Key we would charge twice. our billing dedupe relies on idempotency-key + request fingerprint. if missing, completed runs bill. i'll need invoice id + cust id to process credit.

alice: invoice INV-2026-0034, customer_id cust_824. SDK note: redwood-js v0.9.4 had a regression where Idempotency-Key header was not set for some POSTs — filing to sdk-team.

alice: ledger snippet (sanitized):
```
ledger_row|ts|req|tokens
row_1001|2026-03-16T12:03:21Z|req_01H8XYZ|120
row_1002|2026-03-16T12:03:23Z|req_01H8XYZ|120
```

samir: :thumbsup: i'll queue a manual credit for cust_824 and annotate INV-2026-0034. doing a quick check: both ledger rows have identical body-hash and same client-ip, so this looks like a replay rather than two distinct users.

alice: repro steps for support & eng:
1) call /v1/generate without Idempotency-Key
2) simulate a transient network hiccup so client sees timeout between SDK and ingress
3) SDK retries automatically -> second request reaches runtime and succeeds
result: two successful completions, two billing rows.

nina: short-term mitigation: add a de-dup window at ingress that compares body-hash + client-ip within 2s and drop duplicates (or tag as replay) — needs careful review. long-term: make Idempotency-Key required for non-idempotent endpoints and patch SDKs.

sdk-team: noted. we'll cut a patch for redwood-js 0.9.5 to restore header behavior and push advisory.

infra-oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2026-78 - missing-idempotency-sdk-replay-double-billing

samir: next steps for billing: create refund for the later ledger row, add credit memo to INV-2026-0034, notify acct lead. i'll post refund id here once done.

alice: passing to account team and customer-ops. offering immediate credit and guidance to upgrade SDK + use Idempotency-Key. thanks all. :raising_hand:

customer-ops: customer accepted pro-rated credit offer, wants confirmation when refund applied.

samir: refund issued REF-2026-7901, credited 120 tokens equivalence. updated INV-2026-0034 with note: 'credit for replayed request req_01H8XYZ'. closing on our side after customer confirms. :white_check_mark:
